title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories

info.about: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories is a 2006 action-adventure game developed by Rockstar Leeds and Rockstar North, and published by Rockstar Games. The tenth entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, the game was initially released as a PlayStation Portable exclusive in October 2006.
info.trivia: The last Grand Theft Auto built for a handheld until the phone ports.
info.why: Rockstar sold millions on PSP and ported it to PS2, so supply is deep and prices stay low regardless of condition.
